meta.description: Registry for bounded participation-space measure structures and conditions in Phase 3.

participation_measure_entries.name: Participation Measure Structure
participation_measure_entries.purpose: Represent bounded participation-space measure structures across admissibility-sensitive continuation systems.

participation_measure_conditions.name: finite_participation_structures_permitted
participation_measure_conditions.description: The framework must support participation spaces defined by finite sets of discrete loci.

participation_measure_conditions.name: countable_participation_structures_permitted
participation_measure_conditions.description: Support for infinite but countable participation indices with required summability.

participation_measure_conditions.name: measure_sensitive_participation_scaling_permitted
participation_measure_conditions.description: Participation density may vary according to a formal measure defined over the process locus.

participation_measure_conditions.name: participation_does_not_collapse_into_continuation
participation_measure_conditions.description: The formal distinction between addressable loci (participation) and actualized events (continuation) must be maintained.

participation_measure_conditions.name: epsilon_null_measure_remains_bounded
participation_measure_conditions.description: The measure of the null set near epsilon_null must stay within stability thresholds.

participation_measure_conditions.name: recursive_participation_updates_remain_admissible
participation_measure_conditions.description: Updates to the participation measure itself must respect current admissibility windows.

participation_measure_conditions.name: quantifier_scope_remains_explicit
participation_measure_conditions.description: Universal or existential quantification over participation sets must use bounded, registered domains.

participation_measure_conditions.name: participation_measure_instability_detectable
participation_measure_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register divergence or non-closure in participation scaling.
